title: Life events (life_events.yaml)
description: Required file; may be an empty list. Landing-page life-event cards. Read by catalog_loader.load_life_events into app.models.LifeEvent and served by GET /api/v1/life-events.

slug.description: Unique machine name. The intake treats _ and - alike (new_baby = new-baby). Slugs app/services/life_events.py knows get scenario-specific guidance and starting needs; others get a generic fallback.

icon.description: Icon name the landing page maps (for example ChildFriendly, HomeWork, work); unknown names fall back to a keyword match, then a search icon.
